name: Quartz crystal
description: The equivalent circuit of a quartz crystal or a ceramic resonator with a vector network analyzer (VNA), the crystal in series between the ports: the series and parallel resonances fs and fp, the motional Rm, Lm and Cm, the electrode capacitance C0, the quality factor, the frequency with a load capacitance and its pulling, and a check of the frequency in ppm. Needs only S21: it works with a forward-only VNA such as the LiteVNA.

roles.name: vna
roles.description: The network analyzer, calibrated at the plane of the crystal (one port and a thru)

sweep.description: start_hz, stop_hz, points (narrow and linear, around the resonance), if_bandwidth_hz, power_dbm

device.description: label identifies the crystal; asset_id is its code in the registry

nominal_frequency_hz.description: the frequency the crystal is made for: the offset in ppm is reported

tolerance_ppm.description: pass / fail on the offset (of the frequency with the load if one is given, else of fs)

load_capacitance_pf.description: the load capacitance the crystal is specified for: its frequency and pulling with it

z0.description: reference impedance of the VNA (50 by default)

golden.description: check the result against a golden sample of the project (a good unit of the same kind): name or run, and tolerances = {curves, summary: {figure: tolerance}, min_overlap}

require_calibration.description: stop if the VNA says the data, or the S-parameter read, are not corrected by the calibration (default: warn)

confirm_setup.description: ask, before measuring, to calibrate and connect the crystal
